mapper.select: /* 마케팅 프로젝트 단건 조회 marketing.selectMarketingProject */ SELECT A.MKT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , A.PROJECT_NM AS PROJECT_NM , A.APPROVER_USER_ID AS APPROVER_USER_ID , (SELECT M.USER_ID FROM TB_MKT_MEMBER M WHERE M.MKT_ID = A.MKT_ID AND M.MANAGE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS MANAGER_USER_ID , (SELECT USER_NM FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.APPROVER_USER_ID) AS APPROVER_USER_NM , A.ORG_NM AS ORG_NM , A.PROJECT_OVERVIEW AS PROJECT_OVERVIEW , DATE_FORMAT(A.DUE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DUE_DT , A.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD , C.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM , A.CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT , A.MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(A.MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_MKT A LEFT JOIN TB_CODE C ON C.CODE_GRP_ID = 'MK000001' AND C.CODE_ID = A.STATUS_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.MKT_ID = #{marketingProjectId}

/* 프로젝트 멤버(공개범위) 목록 조회 marketing.selectMarketingProjectMemberList */ SELECT A.MKT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , A.MKT_MEMBER_ID AS MARKETING_MEMBER_ID , A.MANAGE_YN AS MANAGE_YN , A.USER_ID AS USER_ID , B.USER_NM AS USER_NM , B.EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM TB_MKT_MEMBER A LEFT JOIN TB_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE A.MKT_ID = #{marketingProjectId} ORDER BY A.CREATE_DT ASC
mapper.delete: /* 프로젝트 소속 멤버 전체 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingProjectMembersByProject */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_MEMBER WHERE MKT_ID = #{marketingProjectId}
/* 프로젝트 멤버 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingProjectMember */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_MEMBER WHERE MKT_ID = #{marketingProjectId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: /* 마케팅 파일 단건 조회 marketing.selectMarketingFileById */ SELECT MKT_FILE_ID AS MARKETING_FILE_ID , MKT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH , FILE_NM AS FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE , FILE_TYPE AS FILE_TYPE , FILE_PURPOSE_CD AS FILE_PURPOSE_CD , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_MKT_FILE WHERE MKT_FILE_ID = #{marketingFileId}
mapper.delete: /* 프로젝트 소속 첨부파일 전체 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingFilesByProject */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_FILE WHERE MKT_ID = #{marketingProjectId}
mapper.select: /* 마케팅 기획서 단건 조회 marketing.selectMarketingPlan */ SELECT MKT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , MKT_PLAN_ID AS MARKETING_PLAN_ID , GOAL AS GOAL , PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NM , REQUEST_TXT AS REQUEST_TXT , TARGET_NM AS TARGET_NM , KEY_MESSAGE AS KEY_MESSAGE , RECOMMEND_CHANNELS AS RECOMMEND_CHANNELS , VISUAL_TXT AS VISUAL_TXT , SECTIONS_JSON AS SECTIONS_JSON , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID FROM TB_MKT_PLAN WHERE MKT_ID = #{marketingProjectId}
mapper.delete: /* 프로젝트 소속 기획서 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingPlanByProject */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_PLAN WHERE MKT_ID = #{marketingProjectId}
mapper.select: /* 마케팅 콘텐츠 단건 조회 marketing.selectMarketing */ SELECT A.MKT_CONTENT_ID AS MKT_CONTENT_ID , A.MKT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , A.AGENT_ID AS AGENT_ID , A.TITLE AS TITLE , A.OUTPUT_MODE AS OUTPUT_MODE , A.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD , C.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM , A.AI_STATUS_CD AS AI_STATUS_CD , D.CODE_NM AS AI_STATUS_NM , A.CONTENT_TYPE AS CONTENT_TYPE , A.REQUEST_JSON AS REQUEST_JSON , A.GENERATION_SNAPSHOT_JSON AS GENERATION_SNAPSHOT_JSON , A.VARIANT_COUNT AS VARIANT_COUNT , A.CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , A.SELECTED_VARIANT_NO AS SELECTED_VARIANT_NO , A.CONTENT_VERSION AS CONTENT_VERSION , CASE WHEN A.PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT IS NOT NULL AND A.STATUS_CD IN ('005','006','007') THEN 'SCHEDULE' WHEN A.STATUS_CD IN ('006','007') THEN 'NOW' ELSE 'HOLD' END AS PUBLISH_TYPE_CD , A.ALERT_HOUR AS ALERT_HOUR , DATE_FORMAT(A.PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT , CASE WHEN A.STATUS_CD = '006' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PUBLISHED_YN , B.USER_NM AS CREATE_USER_NM , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT A LEFT JOIN TB_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.CREATE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CODE C ON C.CODE_GRP_ID = 'MK000001' AND C.CODE_ID = A.STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CODE D ON D.CODE_GRP_ID = 'MK000002' AND D.CODE_ID = A.AI_STATUS_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{mktContentId}
mapper.update: /* 콘텐츠 버전 증가와 승인 해제 marketing.invalidateMarketingApproval */ UPDATE TB_MKT_CONTENT SET CONTENT_VERSION = CONTENT_VERSION + 1, SELECTED_VARIANT_NO = #{selectedVariantNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, STATUS_CD = '002', PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT = NULL, PUBLISH_COMPLETED_DT = NULL, REQUEST_JSON = #{requestJson, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, MODIFY_USER_ID = #{modifyUserId}, MODIFY_DT = NOW() WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{mktContentId}

/* 발행 설정 저장 marketing.updateMarketingSchedule */ UPDATE TB_MKT_CONTENT SET PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT = #{publishScheduledDt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, PUBLISH_COMPLETED_DT = CASE WHEN #{statusCd} = '006' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}, ALERT_HOUR = #{alertHour}, MODIFY_USER_ID = #{modifyUserId}, MODIFY_DT = NOW() WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{mktContentId}

/* 예약 시각 경과 콘텐츠 발행완료 일괄 전환 marketing.advanceScheduledMarketingToPublished */ UPDATE TB_MKT_CONTENT SET STATUS_CD = '006' , PUBLISH_COMPLETED_DT = NOW() , MODIFY_DT = NOW() WHERE STATUS_CD = '005' AND PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT <= NOW()
mapper.delete: /* 마케팅 콘텐츠 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketing */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{mktContentId}
/* 프로젝트 소속 콘텐츠 전체 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingByProject */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT WHERE MKT_ID = #{marketingProjectId}
mapper.select: /* 캠페인 캘린더 이벤트 목록 marketing.selectCalendarEvents */ SELECT A.MKT_CONTENT_ID AS EVENT_ID , A.MKT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , B.PROJECT_NM AS PROJECT_NM , A.MKT_CONTENT_ID AS CONTENT_ID , A.TITLE AS TITLE , A.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD , DATE_FORMAT( COALESCE(A.PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT, A.PUBLISH_COMPLETED_DT), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS EVENT_DT FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT A INNER JOIN TB_MKT B ON B.MKT_ID = A.MKT_ID INNER JOIN TB_MKT_MEMBER C ON C.MKT_ID = A.MKT_ID AND C.USER_ID = #{value} WHERE A.PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT IS NOT NULL OR A.PUBLISH_COMPLETED_DT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY EVENT_DT DESC

/* 마케팅 콘텐츠 시안 목록 조회 marketing.selectMarketingContents */ SELECT MKT_CONTENT_VARIANT_ID AS MKT_CONTENT_VARIANT_ID , VARIANT_NO AS VARIANT_NO , RECOMMEND_YN AS RECOMMEND_YN , CONTENT_LABEL AS CONTENT_LABEL , TEXT_CONTENT AS TEXT_CONTENT , TEXT_PROMPT_JSON AS TEXT_PROMPT_JSON , IMAGE_PROMPT_JSON AS IMAGE_PROMPT_JSON , IMAGE_FILE AS IMAGE_FILE , MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID , CASE WHEN PREV_TEXT_CONTENT IS NOT NULL OR PREV_IMAGE_FILE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_PREVIOUS_YN FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT_VARIANT WHERE 1 = 1 AND MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{mktContentId} ORDER BY VARIANT_NO

/* 마케팅 콘텐츠 시안 단건 조회 marketing.selectMarketingContent */ SELECT MKT_CONTENT_VARIANT_ID AS MKT_CONTENT_VARIANT_ID , VARIANT_NO AS VARIANT_NO , CONTENT_LABEL AS CONTENT_LABEL , TEXT_CONTENT AS TEXT_CONTENT , TEXT_PROMPT_JSON AS TEXT_PROMPT_JSON , IMAGE_PROMPT_JSON AS IMAGE_PROMPT_JSON , IMAGE_FILE AS IMAGE_FILE FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT_VARIANT WHERE 1 = 1 AND MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{mktContentId} AND VARIANT_NO = #{variantNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: /* 시안 직전 버전으로 되돌리기(백업 없는 필드는 현재값 유지) marketing.restoreMarketingContentPrevious */ UPDATE TB_MKT_CONTENT_VARIANT SET TEXT_PROMPT_JSON = CASE WHEN PREV_TEXT_CONTENT IS NOT NULL THEN PREV_TEXT_PROMPT_JSON ELSE TEXT_PROMPT_JSON END , IMAGE_PROMPT_JSON = CASE WHEN PREV_IMAGE_FILE IS NOT NULL THEN PREV_IMAGE_PROMPT_JSON ELSE IMAGE_PROMPT_JSON END , PREV_TEXT_PROMPT_JSON = NULL, PREV_IMAGE_PROMPT_JSON = NULL , TEXT_CONTENT = COALESCE(PREV_TEXT_CONTENT, TEXT_CONTENT) , IMAGE_FILE = COALESCE(PREV_IMAGE_FILE, IMAGE_FILE) , PREV_TEXT_CONTENT = NULL , PREV_IMAGE_FILE = NULL , MODIFY_USER_ID = #{modifyUserId} , MODIFY_DT = NOW() WHERE MKT_CONTENT_VARIANT_ID = #{mktContentVariantId} AND MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{mktContentId} AND (PREV_TEXT_CONTENT IS NOT NULL OR PREV_IMAGE_FILE IS NOT NULL)
mapper.delete: /* 마케팅 콘텐츠 시안 전체 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingContents */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT_VARIANT WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{mktContentId}
mapper.insert: /* 검수 이력 등록 marketing.insertReviewHistory */ INSERT INTO TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST (MKT_HIST_ID, MKT_CONTENT_ID, VARIANT_NO, CONTENT_VERSION, HIST_TYPE_CD, OUTPUT_MODE, SCORE, VERDICT_CD, RESULT_JSON, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{contentId}, #{variantNo}, #{contentVersion}, '001', #{outputMode}, #{score}, #{verdict}, JSON_OBJECT('checks', CAST(#{checksJson} AS JSON), 'issues', CAST(#{issuesJson} AS JSON)), #{createUserId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: /* 검수 이력 최신 3건 유지 marketing.pruneReviewHistory */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{value} AND HIST_TYPE_CD = '001' AND MKT_HIST_ID NOT IN (SELECT MKT_HIST_ID FROM ( SELECT MKT_HIST_ID FROM TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{value} AND HIST_TYPE_CD = '001' ORDER BY CONTENT_VERSION DESC LIMIT 3) K)
mapper.update: /* 검수 이슈 반영 표시 marketing.updateReviewIssues */ UPDATE TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST SET RESULT_JSON = JSON_SET(RESULT_JSON, '$.issues', CAST(#{issuesJson} AS JSON)) WHERE MKT_HIST_ID = #{reviewId} AND HIST_TYPE_CD = '001'
mapper.select: /* 최신 검수 조회 marketing.selectLatestReview */ SELECT MKT_HIST_ID AS REVIEW_ID, MKT_CONTENT_ID AS CONTENT_ID, VARIANT_NO AS VARIANT_NO, CONTENT_VERSION, CREATE_USER_ID, OUTPUT_MODE, SCORE, VERDICT_CD AS VERDICT, JSON_EXTRACT(RESULT_JSON, '$.checks') AS CHECKS_JSON, JSON_EXTRACT(RESULT_JSON, '$.issues') AS ISSUES_JSON, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REVIEWED_DT FROM TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{value} AND HIST_TYPE_CD = '001' ORDER BY CONTENT_VERSION DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: /* 승인 이력 등록 marketing.insertApprovalHistory */ INSERT INTO TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST (MKT_HIST_ID, MKT_CONTENT_ID, VARIANT_NO, CONTENT_VERSION, HIST_TYPE_CD, REVIEW_HIST_ID, OUTPUT_MODE, SCORE, VERDICT_CD, RESULT_JSON, APPROVED_YN, MEMO, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT) VALUES (#{approvalId}, #{contentId}, #{variantNo}, #{contentVersion}, '002', #{reviewHistId}, #{outputMode}, #{score}, #{verdict}, #{resultJson, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{approvedYn}, #{memo, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{createUserId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: /* 승인 이력 최신 3건 유지 marketing.pruneApprovalHistory */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{value} AND HIST_TYPE_CD = '002' AND MKT_HIST_ID NOT IN (SELECT MKT_HIST_ID FROM ( SELECT MKT_HIST_ID FROM TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{value} AND HIST_TYPE_CD = '002' ORDER BY CONTENT_VERSION DESC LIMIT 3) K)
mapper.select: /* 최신 승인 조회 marketing.selectLatestApproval */ SELECT MKT_HIST_ID AS APPROVAL_ID, MKT_CONTENT_ID AS CONTENT_ID, VARIANT_NO AS VARIANT_NO, CONTENT_VERSION, CREATE_USER_ID, REVIEW_HIST_ID, OUTPUT_MODE, SCORE, VERDICT_CD AS VERDICT, RESULT_JSON, MEMO, APPROVED_YN, (SELECT USER_NM FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = H.CREATE_USER_ID) AS REVIEWER_NM, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS APPROVED_DT FROM TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST H WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{value} AND HIST_TYPE_CD = '002' ORDER BY CONTENT_VERSION DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: /* 콘텐츠 통합 이력 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingHistories */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_WORKFLOW_HIST WHERE MKT_CONTENT_ID = #{mktContentId}
